from pathlib import Path
Path("cache/dual-unlocked.sh").write_text("""#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/vesanieminen/code/gpu-unlock-benchmarks
export PATH="$PWD/cache/docker-pkexec-bin:$PATH"
export BENCH_SYSTEM=dual-rtx3090
python3 record.py --system dual-rtx3090 --phase workload-stop -- pkexec systemctl stop llama-swap.service
python3 record.py --system dual-rtx3090 --phase unlocked-readiness -- bash -x -c 'set -e; test "$(systemctl is-active llama-swap.service)" = inactive; test -z "$(nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid --format=csv,noheader)"; nvidia-smi; journalctl -k -b --no-pager --grep="pci .*gpu_unlock: unlocked"'
BENCH_GPU=0 bash run.sh torch unlocked-gpu0
BENCH_GPU=1 bash run.sh torch unlocked-gpu1
BENCH_TP=2 bash run.sh vllm unlocked
""")
print("Prepared matching unlocked sequence")
